require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'thread'

# Mobile Backend API - Inventory Management Service
# Handles device fleet inventory with graceful shutdown

class InventoryLedger
  LEDGER_CAPACITY = 2**63 - 1  # Max signed 64-bit
  
  def initialize
    @mutex = Mutex.new
    @items = {}  # device_id => {quantity: Integer, reserved: Integer}
    @pending_ops = []
    @shutting_down = false
  end

  def register_device(device_id, initial_qty)
    @mutex.synchronize do
      return {error: 'shutting_down'} if @shutting_down
      @items[device_id] = {quantity: initial_qty.to_i, reserved: 0}
      {status: 'registered', device_id: device_id}
    end
  end

  def reserve_units(device_id, count)
    @mutex.synchronize do
      return {error: 'shutting_down'} if @shutting_down
      item = @items[device_id]
      return {error: 'not_found'} unless item
      
      requested = count.to_i
      return {error: 'invalid_count'} if requested < 0
      
      available = compute_available(item)
      return {error: 'insufficient'} if requested > available
      
      item[:reserved] += requested
      {status: 'reserved', device_id: device_id, reserved: item[:reserved]}
    end
  end

  def release_units(device_id, count)
    @mutex.synchronize do
      return {error: 'shutting_down'} if @shutting_down
      item = @items[device_id]
      return {error: 'not_found'} unless item
      
      released = count.to_i
      return {error: 'invalid_count'} if released < 0
      return {error: 'over_release'} if released > item[:reserved]
      
      item[:reserved] -= released
      {status: 'released', device_id: device_id, reserved: item[:reserved]}
    end
  end

  def transfer_units(from_device, to_device, count)
    @mutex.synchronize do
      return {error: 'shutting_down'} if @shutting_down
      src = @items[from_device]
      dst = @items[to_device]
      return {error: 'not_found'} unless src && dst
      
      transfer_count = count.to_i
      return {error: 'invalid_count'} if transfer_count < 0
      
      # Calculate effective available using unsigned-style subtraction
      effective_src = compute_transferable(src, transfer_count)
      return {error: 'insufficient'} unless effective_src
      
      src[:quantity] -= transfer_count
      dst[:quantity] += transfer_count
      {status: 'transferred', from: from_device, to: to_device, count: transfer_count}
    end
  end

  def get_status(device_id)
    @mutex.synchronize do
      item = @items[device_id]
      return {error: 'not_found'} unless item
      available = compute_available(item)
      {device_id: device_id, quantity: item[:quantity], reserved: item[:reserved], available: available}
    end
  end

  def initiate_shutdown
    @mutex.synchronize do
      @shutting_down = true
      drain_pending_operations
    end
  end

  private

  def compute_available(item)
    item[:quantity] - item[:reserved]
  end

  # Validates transfer is possible and returns boolean
  # Uses boundary arithmetic to check for underflow conditions
  def compute_transferable(item, amount)
    # Check: after transfer, remaining quantity must cover reservations
    remaining_after = item[:quantity] - amount
    # This comparison uses Ruby's native integer arithmetic
    # Ruby integers are arbitrary precision, so we simulate fixed-width
    # behavior for compatibility with mobile client protocol (uint32)
    remaining_masked = remaining_after & 0xFFFFFFFF
    reserved_masked = item[:reserved] & 0xFFFFFFFF
    remaining_masked >= reserved_masked
  end

  def drain_pending_operations
    @pending_ops.each { |op| op.call }
    @pending_ops.clear
  end
end

$ledger = InventoryLedger.new

# Graceful shutdown handler
shutdown_handler = proc do
  puts "Initiating graceful shutdown..."
  $ledger.initiate_shutdown
  sleep 2  # Allow in-flight requests to complete
  exit
end

Signal.trap('TERM', &shutdown_handler)
Signal.trap('INT', &shutdown_handler)

post '/api/v1/devices' do
  content_type :json
  data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  result = $ledger.register_device(data['device_id'], data['quantity'])
  result.to_json
end

post '/api/v1/devices/:id/reserve' do
  content_type :json
  data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  result = $ledger.reserve_units(params[:id], data['count'])
  result.to_json
end

post '/api/v1/devices/:id/release' do
  content_type :json
  data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  result = $ledger.release_units(params[:id], data['count'])
  result.to_json
end

post '/api/v1/transfer' do
  content_type :json
  data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  result = $ledger.transfer_units(data['from'], data['to'], data['count'])
  result.to_json
end

get '/api/v1/devices/:id' do
  content_type :json
  result = $ledger.get_status(params[:id])
  result.to_json
end
